This division of this Act, being 18 deemed of immediate importance, takes effect upon enactment. 19 EXPLANATION 20 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 21 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 22 This bill relates to activities, programs, and services 23 under the purview of the department of health and human 24 services (HHS). 25 DIVISION I —— HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES DISTRICTS. The bill 26 directs HHS to divide the state into health and human services 27 districts (districts), as defined in the bill, to be used by 28 HHS in the delivery of programs and services. The initial 29 districts shall be the same as the behavioral health districts 30 designated in Code section 225A.4, Code 2026, as the behavioral 31 health districts exist on the effective date of this division 32 of the bill. The bill provides factors HHS must consider when 33 modifying the districts. The manner in which HHS modifies a 34 district is not subject to judicial review. 35 -12- LSB 5558XD (10) 91 dg/ko 12/ 14 S.F. _____ H.F. _____ The bill changes Code chapter 225A (HHS —— behavioral health 1 service system) so that behavioral health services are provided 2 through the health and human services districts instead of 3 behavioral health districts. 4 The bill makes conforming changes to Code section 12.51. 5 This division of the bill takes effect upon enactment. 6 DIVISION II —— AGING AND DISABILITY SERVICES. Under current 7 law, HHS is required to divide the state into distinct planning 8 and service areas based on various factors for the purpose of 9 providing aging and disability services. The bill requires 10 HHS to designate each planning and service area (service area) 11 throughout the state in accordance with federal requirements. 12 The boundaries of service areas shall match the boundaries of 13 districts. 14 This division of the bill takes effect upon enactment 15 and applies upon HHS’s receipt, from the administration for 16 community living of the United States department of health and 17 human services, of approval of the planning and service areas 18 as amended in the bill. 19 DIVISION III —— VOLUNTEER SERVICES. The bill creates a 20 subunit for volunteerism (subunit) within HHS. The subunit 21 shall establish volunteer programs designed to enhance the 22 services provided by HHS and provide administrative support 23 for the nonpolicymaking duties of the Iowa commission on 24 volunteer service (commission). The director of HHS shall 25 appoint an executive director to oversee the administration of 26 the subunit and to carry out nonpolicymaking duties delegated 27 to the subunit by the commission. HHS may employ personnel 28 for the subunit to carry out the duties of the subunit and 29 the duties delegated to the subunit by the commission.
